include.description: Globs (source path or source:Contract) to consider. Empty means all.

exclude.description: Globs to skip. Replaces the default list.

extraExclude.description: Globs to skip in addition to the defaults.

contracts.description: Contracts always checked, by name, source path or source:Contract glob.

storage-var-removed.description: A state variable from the base layout no longer exists.

storage-var-moved.description: A state variable now lives at a different slot or offset.

storage-var-inserted.description: A new state variable occupies storage that was used in the base layout.

storage-var-packed.description: A new state variable was packed into bytes the base layout left unused, before the end of the layout.

storage-var-replaced.description: A different variable with an incompatible type occupies an existing slot.

storage-var-renamed.description: A variable at the same position was renamed (same type). Safe for storage, but check intent.

storage-type-changed.description: A state variable's type changed in a way that reinterprets existing data.

storage-type-compatible.description: A type changed, but the encoding is compatible (e.g. address to contract type, struct members appended inside a mapping).

storage-var-appended.description: A new state variable was appended after the existing layout. Safe.

storage-gap-changed.description: A storage gap was resized so that the variables after it shift.

storage-gap-consumed.description: New variables use space reserved by a storage gap, and the gap shrank to match. Safe.

storage-layout-missing.description: No storage layout was produced for this contract, so storage could not be checked.

abi-function-removed.description: A function was removed or its signature (selector) changed.

abi-function-outputs-changed.description: A function's return types changed, so existing callers decode the wrong data.

abi-function-mutability-changed.description: A function's state mutability changed (e.g. view to nonpayable, payable to nonpayable).

abi-event-removed.description: An event was removed or its signature (topic) changed; indexers and subgraphs stop seeing it.

abi-event-indexed-changed.description: An event kept its signature but changed which parameters are indexed, which changes its log layout.

abi-error-removed.description: A custom error was removed or its signature changed.

abi-receive-removed.description: The receive function was removed; plain ETH transfers now revert.

contract-removed.description: A contract that was checked on the base branch no longer exists.
